title: Book Three · Chapter 27: The First Holiday Morning
story:
On Friday, the winter holiday begins.

Ronan wakes at the usual time. For a moment, he reaches for his school shirt. Then he leaves it on the chair and lies back down.

Outside, Dad is already washing. Mum is opening her box of thread.

Ronan closes his eyes. He hears a bowl touch the table. Then the kettle lid rattles.

He gets up.

“No school today,” Dad says.

“I remembered.”

“Then why are you dressed?”

“Breakfast.”

Dad moves the bread closer. Ronan sits down in his warm old coat. There are no books beside his bowl.

Mum has two coats to finish before the weekend. One needs new cuffs. Dad has a full day at Mr Sun's place.

“Can we go out on Sunday?” Ronan asks.

“After lunch,” Mum says. “I want to see the street stalls.”

Dad nods. “I finish at noon.”

Ronan breaks his bread in half. Tomorrow is the market with Kai. On Sunday, he can go with Mum and Dad.

Dad eats quickly, washes his bowl, and leaves for work. Mum takes the first coat to the window.

Ronan clears the table. He carries the cups into the kitchen and wipes the wet marks away.

“You can leave the cloth there,” Mum says.

“What else?”

“Nothing just now. I need to measure this sleeve.”

He goes into the yard. His bike stands beside the wall. A dry leaf is caught between the front wheel and the frame.

Ronan pulls it free. He wipes the seat with a rag, then moves the bike into a patch of sun.

The old bell makes a clear sound under his thumb.

Mr Qiu looks through the gate.

“School holiday?”

“First day.”

“Mine starts when these boxes are empty.”

Ronan looks at the pencils. “A long holiday?”

“A short one, I hope. Then I need more pencils.”

Ronan smiles. He puts the bike back and carries his school books outside.

He wants the morning free tomorrow. He can finish some work today.

At the window, Mum stops her needle and looks at a cuff. She unpicks two stitches, then starts that part again.

Ronan reads the first question. He works for a while, then gets up to stretch.

The sun has moved across the yard. He draws his chair into it and sits down again.

When Mum comes out, he has one question left.

“Tea?” she asks.

He moves his book away from the edge of the table.

“Yes, please.”

She brings two cups. Ronan breaks the last piece of breakfast bread and gives her half.

“Still holiday bread?” she asks.

“Until lunch.”

They sit in the sun for a few minutes. Then Mum returns to the cuff, and Ronan finishes his last question.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

cuff＝袖口；frame＝自行车车架；rag＝抹布；unpick＝拆掉缝好的针脚。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan放假第一天，父母有没有同时放假？他们约好什么时候一起出去？
2. Ronan为什么选择先做一部分作业？他和Mum怎样休息了一会儿？

## 读句子

**He draws his chair into it and sits down again.**

拆开看：He / draws his chair into it / and sits down again.

他／把椅子挪进那片阳光里／再次坐下。
